title: Heaviside Step Function
subtitle: Special Functions · Unit step
summary: Unit step function. Distributional derivative is the Dirac delta.
detail:
\[ H(x) = \begin{cases}0 & x<0\\1 & x\ge 0\end{cases} \]

Used to represent switched-on signals. \(H'(x)=\delta(x)\) in the distributional sense. The Laplace transform of \(H(t)\) is \(1/s\). Often used to write piecewise functions compactly: \(f(x)H(x-a)\) equals \(f(x)\) for \(x\ge a\) and 0 otherwise.
